title: platform_cfg.json hookConfig object
description: Board facts for the shared IST hooks. The build turns this object into /etc/ist/platform.env, which the hooks source.

domains.description: One entry per set of IST lines (a CPU board or module), handled in order.

resetMethod.description: How ist_sys_rst.sh resets the CPUs. Omitted means gpio; that default is intended, so resetMethod is deliberately not required. gpio: drive preResetGpio, wait for shutdownOkGpio, pulse sysResetGpio. command: run resetCommand and nothing else (no MCTP wait, no CAK bypass). hostWarmReboot: for boards whose CPU reset lines belong to x86-power-control (vc-256); request ForceWarmReboot on host0 and wait for CpuResetIndicator to go 0 then 1.

resetCommand.description: Command run by ist_sys_rst.sh for resetMethod command; its exit status is the hook's.

cakBypass.description: Present: the daemon runs ist_cak_bypass.sh after each power cycle and fails the run if it is missing, and ist_sys_rst.sh runs it after the reset. Absent: the board has no volatile DOT support and no CAK bypass runs.

dotObjectPrefix.description: NSM DOT object path prefix; the CPU index is appended, e.g. /xyz/openbmc_project/DOT/IRoT_CPU_.

requiredCpus.description: Skip the CAK bypass (exit 0) when fewer CPUs than this are present: a short count means a partially populated machine, which is not an IST configuration (vr-nvl). Only for boards whose CPU discovery is definitive (GPIO detect). Must not exceed the CPUs declared, and cannot be combined with absentOnProduct, where a short count is a smaller product that still needs the bypass.

timings.description: Optional timing overrides. None is read for resetMethod command.

shutdownOkTimeoutS.description: gpio: wait for shutdownOkGpio to assert after preResetGpio. hostWarmReboot: each of the two CpuResetIndicator waits. Default 10.

shutdownOkPollS.description: gpio only: shutdownOkGpio poll interval. Default 0.2.

sysResetHoldS.description: gpio only: how long sysResetGpio is held low. Default 5.

eidTimeoutS.description: gpio and hostWarmReboot: wait for the CPU MCTP endpoints after a reset, before one more reset and a second wait. A healthy C2 reset has taken 3 to 15 s and expiring early costs an unneeded CPU reset, but two waits and a reset must still fit in the IST service's hook timeout. Default 45.

allOf.$comment: resetMethod is not required here on purpose: omitted means gpio.

detect.description: Treat the domain as present only if gpiofind finds its GPIO lines; a domain not found is skipped by every hook. This is SKU identification, not just absent-tray handling: vr-nvl has an internal single-CPU configuration with no FRU field to identify it, so GPIO presence is the only way to tell. gpio resetMethod only, because presence is decided by preResetGpio.

istBootGpio.description: Driven 1 by ist_boot_enable.sh and 0 by ist_boot_disable.sh.

preResetGpio.description: gpio resetMethod: asserted low to request the CPU shutdown.

shutdownOkGpio.description: gpio resetMethod: reads 0 once the CPU is ready for reset.

sysResetGpio.description: gpio resetMethod: pulsed low for sysResetHoldS to reset the CPU.

fruProductMatch.description: Substrings of FruDevice PRODUCT_PRODUCT_NAME; the first FRU containing one gives the domain's product, which absentOnProduct is compared against.

cpus.description: CPUs reset with this domain. Required unless resetMethod is command.

index.description: CPU index, appended to dotObjectPrefix. Unique across domains.

eid.description: MCTP EID that must return after a reset. Must match StaticEndpointID in the board's entity-manager MCTP configuration.

absentOnProduct.description: The CPU is not fitted when the domain's product is this fruProductMatch entry, e.g. CPU 1 on an MGX C1. That smaller product is a valid configuration and still gets the CAK bypass; cannot be combined with requiredCpus.
